title: sprite.ts: motion tweens inside symbol timelines not interpolated
description: encodeDefineSprite() in packages/swf/src/sprite.ts uses findGoverningKeyframe() (returns the static keyframe) instead of getTweenedFrame() for per-frame position lookup. As a result, any motion tween defined inside a library symbol timeline is silently dropped: every frame of the symbol shows the start-keyframe position, making the symbol appear to jump rather than smoothly animate.\n\nFix: replace the findGoverningKeyframe() call at line 199 with getTweenedFrame(layer, frameIdx, timeline). getTweenedFrame() is already exported from @flash/core and used correctly in compile.ts for scene timelines. The symbol's own timeline object should be passed as the third argument so guide-path interpolation still works for guided layers inside symbols.
